title: Group Underwriting Guidelines for Employer Group Contracts
content:
These guidelines govern how a new Employer Group Contract is placed, written and brought into force in the Cascade Group Dental & Vision series.

## 1. Placement in a segment

A group is placed in the segment whose fewest and most eligible employees contain its eligible employees on the census. The eligible employees on the census are recorded on the application.

## 2. Situs

A group may be written only in the states the segment schedule lists as the states where Cascade issues group contracts. A group whose situs state is not on that list is not written.

## 3. Application and effective date

A group must submit a complete application the segment's application lead time before the requested effective date, which is always the segment's effective day of a month, the day of the month on which new contracts and changes take effect.

## 4. Employer contribution

A contributory group must pay at least the segment's employer minimum contribution, a percent of employee-only premium.

## 5. Participation

The group must meet the participation minimum for its contribution type:

| Contribution type | Participation minimum the group must meet |
|---|---|
| Employer-paid (the employer pays all premium) | the segment's employer-paid participation minimum |
| Contributory | the segment's contributory participation minimum |
| Voluntary | the segment's voluntary participation minimum together with the segment's voluntary minimum enrolled lives |

For a voluntary group the two figures are met together or the minimum is not met:

| Voluntary percentage reached | Voluntary enrolled lives reached | Voluntary participation minimum |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | met |
| yes | no | not met |
| no | yes | not met |
| no | no | not met |

## 6. Rate guarantee

Rates are guaranteed for the segment's rate guarantee for a new contract, counted from the effective date.

## Per-segment figures applied by these guidelines

| Segment | Contributory participation minimum | Rate guarantee for a new contract |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 2-19 | 75 percent | 12 months |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 20-49 | 75 percent | 12 months |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 50-99 | 60 percent | 12 months |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 100-249 | 50 percent | 24 months |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 | 40 percent | 24 months |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 1000 Plus | 25 percent | 24 months |

## 7. Taking effect and withdrawal

The contract becomes active on its effective date once the group account's binder is received, and the employer may withdraw before then.

| Contract status | Moves to | When | By |
|---|---|---|---|
| Applied | Active | on its effective date, after underwriting approval and the binder | the company's system |
| Applied | Cancelled | when the employer withdraws the application before the effective date | the employer |

A withdrawn application is recorded as cancelled, with an end date of the day before the requested effective date and the reason "application withdrawn". Hypothetical illustration: an application requesting an effective date of the first of July that the employer withdraws in June is recorded as cancelled with an end date of June 30.

## 8. What the application records

An accepted application records the segment, the group number assigned, the situs state, the contribution type and the employer's share, the dental plan and the vision plan offered, the quoted dental rates for member only, member and spouse, member and children and family, the quoted vision rates for member only and family, the eligible employees on the census, the employer's new-hire waiting period, the requested effective date, the renewal date (the first anniversary) and the end of the initial rate guarantee.
